flows:
Navigate to https://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp#main then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Reach the leftmost swatch in the top row of the color map labeled #003366.
Press Enter and verify the selected color reads #003366.

Update the keyboard-navigation policy to detect a visible consent dialog after the mandatory two Tab presses, use its focused Accept button with Enter when allowed, wait for it to close, and then continue toward the map.

verdict.root_cause: A consent pop-up was blocking the page, but the agent kept moving focus through navigation links rather than using the visible dialog controls and then continuing to the map.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome by continuing to press Tab through header items while a visible consent dialog covered the color map. After the required first two Tab presses, it did not use the dialog's focused Accept control with Enter or otherwise adapt its navigation strategy, so it exhausted the run without reaching the requested swatch.

verdict.suggestion: Update the keyboard-navigation policy to detect a visible consent dialog after the mandatory two Tab presses, use its focused Accept button with Enter when allowed, wait for it to close, and then continue toward the map.
